purpose: Focused final-response integrity repair; stop for external review.
executive_summary: B — INTEGRITY REPAIR QUALIFIED WITH LIMITATIONS. Original failure reproduced before production edits, then repaired. Final fresh qualification: 24 turns, exact authorized/API/history agreement on 24/24; 5 rejected fresh expression candidates. Relevant baseline {'passed': 692, 'failed': 25}; final {'passed': 692, 'failed': 25}; new failures 0. 63 focused checks pass.

production: Immutable fixed host fallback; pinned exact adoption and identity; missing-adoption reauthorization; exact history, commitments and API delivery; selected public facts validated before sealing.
validation: Frozen original and legacy retry regressions, adversarial tests, exact comparison and 24 fresh HTTP turns.
tooling: Isolated qualification runner and evidence-derived report builder.
documentation: 27 required reports and centralized review bundle.
generated_artifacts: Raw controlled/fresh evidence, JUnit identities, source diffs, gate/performance/preservation audits.

testing.runtime_validation: Two independent 12-turn fresh-provider /api/chat conversations; real snapshot tests and structured-action controlled HTTP.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Configured OpenAI Responses API; exact returned IDs/usage retained. Controlled outputs never labeled fresh.

campaign_specific: Bounded sample; general dialogue quality unresolved.
pre_existing: 25 inherited regression failures; exact identities in comparison.

decisions_requiring_human_review: External review before any next cycle.
missing_concepts: Broad playability and architecture reassessment are outside this cycle.
does_not_prove: Full-repository regression success, conversational playability, or a formal future-proof guarantee.
recommended_next_step: Stop after R4-R1 and await external review.
